guide.title: User Guide
guide.importDesc1: Drag and drop or click to upload audio files on the Song Import page
guide.importDesc2: Supported formats: ncm / mp3 / flac / wav / mp4
guide.importDesc3: NCM files are decrypted via um-react and converted to MP3; you can also open um-react from the sidebar "Decrypt Songs" button to decrypt separately and import in one click
guide.importDesc4: NCM decryption is for learning purposes only. Please support legal music
guide.dormDesc1: Shown as weekly cards; each time slot is a node on the timeline
guide.dormDesc2: Click Add Song and type the title inline; it saves on blur
guide.dormDesc3: The bottom-right button configures time slots; recently played songs with the same name are flagged in yellow
guide.broadcastDesc1: Managed by week, split into noon and afternoon slots
guide.broadcastDesc2: Multiple songs can be scheduled in the same slot
guide.exportDesc1: Pick target dates (cross-week allowed); simple table and poster modes available
guide.exportDesc2: Poster mode supports custom background image and blur
guide.exportDesc3: Exported as a PNG image with the week number in the file name
guide.organizeDesc1: Quickly copy a whole week of songs to another week for card swaps
guide.organizeDesc2: Missing songs can be filled with silent placeholder files
guide.mobileDesc1: On the same LAN, phones can order songs by visiting this machine's address
guide.mobileDesc2: The desktop bottom-left button shows the mobile ordering entry
guide.decryptDesc1: Embedded um-react tool; decryption runs entirely in the browser
guide.decryptDesc2: After decryption, import to the Song Import page in one click
guide.resetPasswordDesc1: If you forgot your advanced settings password:
guide.resetPasswordDesc3: Delete the adminPasswordHash field to reset the password

about.softwareIntro: XiaoBo Song Request Tool is an all-in-one playlist management tool for campus broadcast stations, supporting NCM decryption, audio conversion, time-slot assignment, playlist export, and file organization.
about.authorIntro: EganSama (105 Wen Jiachen), an independent developer dedicated to simplifying the repetitive work of campus broadcasting with straightforward tools.
